steps.text: Rhodes Island Landship
In some remote corner...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Clearing foreign matter, closing wounds, wiping the blood away.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: This is what little I can do.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: For finer treatment, you'll need the aid of a professional doctor from the Medical Department.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: ...This will be enough.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Where will you go?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Back to where I belong.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: To where you belong...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: You mean to say... all alone, by yourself?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: W-Won't you go celebrate with your team? You've all been on such an important mission this time, and their spirits are so high, and you could surely be together...

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: I need not.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: In times of celebration, there need not be me. Under the midday sun, there need not be shadow.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Perhaps the one who ought to join the celebrations is you.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: That... I can't...

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: As you see fit.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: ...I should be taking my leave.
—Hold it!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I finally found you, Operator Phantom!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Dr. Whisperain, were you tending to his wounds just now?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Ah... yes...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Though you may not formally be on the Medical Department's roster of doctors, I still have a responsibility to remind you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: According to the 'Regulations for Management and Treatment of Rhodes Island Wounded Personnel,' all wounded Operators must undergo registration at the Rhodes Island Medical Department.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: When people treat Operators' wounds in private like you have, we can put the little cuts and illnesses aside, but on the off-chance any complications arise in Operator Phantom's condition or from his wounds owing to your incomplete care, that creates a headache for the Medical Department.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I'm so sorry...

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: The one who asked Miss Whisperain for treatment was I.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: There is no need to blame her.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm just telling her the facts.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: As for you, Operator Phantom, you're the bigger problem here!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Why didn't you report to the Medical Department following your injuries?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If Blue Poison hadn't been on the same mission and she hadn't informed me about you during treatment, would you have just taken your pain all the way into the next battle?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This is irresponsible to the company, and irresponsible to yourself.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I hope you can recognize that.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: The fault is mine.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: I deeply apologize to you, dear doctor.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right. I accept your apology.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Now, I need to issue you diagnosis and treatment, along with a full check on your state of health. No problem?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Don't give me that look. Hold on! Mouth shut! Don't make a sound! You're not using your Arts to slip out of here!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'm not letting last time repeat itself. If I notice anything even slightly fishy, there's a pushbutton alarm here and I WILL immediately sound it!

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Was there always such a button on the wall...?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just relax. There'll be no corridors. I'm not taking you to the Medical Department.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Blue Poison's told me you don't like places with a lot of people.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: So I've brought all the equipment here.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I'll help you collect and sort out your treatment information, and then I'll treat your wounds for you with Dr. Whisperain.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No problem, Dr. Whisperain?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: By all means.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Will that be okay, then, Operator Phantom?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Silent nod)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Good. Then I'll begin your diagnosis and treatment immediately.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If possible, could you describe for me the rough location and nature of your wounds?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Why aren't you talking?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Points at sealed lips)

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I believe it's because you told him 'mouth shut' just prior, Folinic.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Rolls eyes)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You can talk now. Please go ahead.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: A crossbow bolt piercing the shoulder, a blade slashed across the palm, ice binding both feet.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Shoulder, perforation wound; injury to hand caused by sharp weapon; hypothermia...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: No effect observed in right leg, but lower left leg appears not fully recovered.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right, let's deal with these one by one.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Shoulder perforation wound.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I closed the wound just prior. There should be no jeopardy.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hm... If it was just an ordinary metal bolt, then we're good.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Did you debride?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Already sorted.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Judging from the healing of the wound, there should be no possibility of poisoning or infection.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right. Next item.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Laceration to the palm.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Hm. Seems to be healing well.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: However, with two separate wounds, we have a substantially higher risk of infection, so in a moment, I'll give you a prophylactic injection. That should solve that worry.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Finally, frostbite on the left lower leg.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay, alright. Stay like that, don't move. I brought the detection apparatus just for this.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This might hurt a little. Hold your breath.
Sample collected.
Beginning analysis—

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Once the numbers come out, I can give final diagnostic conclusions.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Any other discomfort or injuries anywhere?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Hm?)

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Miss.Christine? You seem to have something in your mouth...)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: —Are you listening to me?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Mm. No, no other injuries.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Your recuperative capacity truly is outstanding, Operator Phantom.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Maybe I really have been overly concerned.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Operator Phan—Rather, Phantom, you're a specialist operator, aren't you?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: So they call me.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But your mix of wounds is more numerous than I've seen on vanguard or defender operators.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I've heard your mission this time was extremely difficult.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: 'It's lucky we had him supporting us. We wouldn't have come back alive otherwise.' I've already heard from plenty of others to that effect.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But most of them don't know your codename, and have never even seen your form. They only know the shadow flashing across the battlefield helped them out.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: They have nothing to gain from remembering me.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Sick of hearing that. All the operators I've treated before love stressing that one.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let's drop that. Cut down on chatter. Most of the us here aren't that naive, or maybe one day we're all going to go our separate ways. Hell, imagine if one day we all end up meeting on the battlefield.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: But Phantom, and I may be meddling... I feel I need to tell you that, at least right now, they just want to express their gratitude, nothing more.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Some words you might never have another chance to tell someone, if you don't tell them when you can.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Quietly) ...Don't be a goddamned idiot like me, choking everything down inside.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Blue Poison told me you blocked a crossbow bolt for her.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She wanted to thank you, but couldn't find you, so entrusted me with bringing these things here.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This brooch is a present from her to you. Please, take it.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Just take it.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Many thanks.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: I will relay my gratitude to her.
Analysis complete
Now outputting analysis report

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That's not reassuring.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Mr. Phantom, can you try and move for me?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (A slightly uncoordinated walk)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right. That'll be fine. You can sit down for now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Presumably frostbite from hypothermic temperatures caused by Originium Arts.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Not severe, but it's already affected your mobility.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Just some small injuries.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Please leave distinguishing minor injuries to the professional opinion of a medic, thank you.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: You'd best convalesce for now.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: That would be my opinion.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I agree with Dr. Whisperain's view.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It might be frostbite on the surface, but it's still essentially fine Arts damage.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: We aren't optimistic about your Oripathy infection in the first place. We all need to do our best to avoid any situation that could worsen its progression.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Ample rest, a healthy diet, and appropriate restorative exercise. These are what you need right now.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Of course, the most important thing is that you regularly come to the Medical Department for treatment.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Your treatment course won't be too long. Just one month, and you'll be able to take part in missions again.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If you don't like the idea of coming to the Medical Department, I can help set up rounds for you to lessen your contact with others.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: If you consent, then please sign at the end of this statement.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Another sigh)

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Signs his own codename)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Good. Thank you for cooperating.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Now I should give you your injection.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: This is a new model of syringe. It won't leave too much of an ache.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Please hold your arm out.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: (Uses syringe)

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Right. With that, initial prophylactic treatment is a success.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I won't bother either of you any further.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: You're on vacation for a month, so live it up, Phantom.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: She's gone now.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Phew... It seems I'm still not quite used to talking with Folinic. I always get so nervous...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Fine, more or less.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Miss.Christine

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: (She rubs against Phantom.)

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Don't, now.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I'd like for you to rest well on your coming vacation.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Vacation?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: I've never thought about it before. Vacation. What should I do...?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Erm, perhaps... see a movie?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: If I were in your shoes, I might go and see one. And then I'd make a record of how I felt all the while.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: During them, I always end up fantasizing for myself a life like the people in the pictures, and at the same time, in a contradictory way, I can feel how I truly breathe, outside of the screen...

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Take care.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Fantasizing of living another's life is no good thing.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I understand. It's just that, it's a habit of mine, a way to relax.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: And moreover... it's a little embarrassing to admit, but it seems as though there are some operators who very much like to read the things I end up writing...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I don't personally believe I write all that well, but if it's enough for everyone to enjoy, then I feel it might not be so bad this way.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow—

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Miss.Christine

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: That tickles. Don't you... hm? What is this?

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: If I had to guess, she might want you to take a look at this leaflet.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: 'Wanted: Multiple staff members for a Multimedia Escape Experience event—'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: 'Staff required to take charge in planning escape rooms in whole, for an urgent and pressing adventurous atmosphere.'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: 'Staff required to plan deciphering and mechanisms within escape rooms.'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: 'Staff required to—'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: '—act out roles.'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: 'Design (until opening) to last one month. Salaried for the duration, with three meals a day included.'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: 'Interested operators and staff aboard, please find details at the Human Resources Department.'

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Multimedia escape experience...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I've heard it's a new manner of entertainment, one that emphasizes stimulating the senses and immersive experiences.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: It seems as though... most escape experiences are themed to rely principally on elements of terror and suspense.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I'd seen one, some time before. Its theme was an underground labyrinth in Minos.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Truthfully, I wanted very much to give it a try.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: But that day, the A1 Detachment's Operators told me after experiencing it themselves—

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: 'It scared me to death!'

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Yet, while they told me that, they seemed to be so happy.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Fear, but with joy?)

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: (Hm... Enjoying being frightened?)

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: I didn't dare go back then, and now that I think of it, maybe I regret that a little...

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: Perhaps, this time, I can. Er, should I ask Weedy to come with me?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Miss.Christine, were you hoping for me to see this?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Meow!

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: I believe I understand what you mean.

steps.name: Whisperain
steps.text: You're leaving, now? So, have you decided on where to go for your vacation?

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Just some concept of it.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: If the right amount of fear can serve to bring others merriment.

steps.name: Phantom
steps.text: Perhaps... I can give it a try.
